title: MCE: A framework for handling missing modalities under imbalanced missing rates
core_idea: Address the challenge of imbalanced missing modalities by proposing Modality Capability Enhancement (MCE), which combines Learning Capability Enhancement (LCE) — using multi-level factors to dynamically balance modality-specific learning progress — and Representation Capability Enhancement (RCE) — improving feature semantics and robustness via subset prediction and cross-modal completion tasks.
tldr: Introduce MCE, a two-part framework (LCE + RCE) to dynamically balance modality learning and strengthen representations for handling imbalanced missing modalities.
